name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: Run kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript on every pending video now. It’s the fastest way to hit +5% daily coverage without adding human labor. The trade-off is raw transcript quality—some videos may need cleanup—but that’s a downstream fix, not a blocker. If we wait for perfect transcripts, coverage stalls.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk isn’t cleanup labor—it’s hitting a quota wall before coverage climbs. Luma’s transcript tool caps at 100 pulls/day; if we burn that quota on raw transcripts, we stall at 5% daily growth. The better alternative is to pre-filter videos: skip those with existing transcripts or low engagement, then run kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript only on the remainder. Settle it by testing the filter’s hit rate—if it cuts daily pulls by 30% or more, we proceed.
